'''Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun''' was a [[Krex (species)|Krex]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[General/Legends|general]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Third Galactic War|new conflict]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Daeruun participated in the [[Invasion of Ossus|defense]] of the [[Jedi Colony]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], repelled the [[Nova Blades]]' [[Dantooine Incursion|incursion]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], and led the efforts for the defense of the [[Meridian Complex]] during the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex]].

==Biography==
Around [[3628 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|5.10.0}}</ref> Daeruun was overseeing the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military's]] deployments along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian hyperroute]]. He was alerted to an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] presence near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], discovering the hidden [[Jedi Colony]] there. He sought the assistance of the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] but she was not able to help. Due to the colony's proximity to Imperial space, Daeruun was not able to get the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] authorization to send reinforcements but regardless, he started assembling them although taking more time for this task.<ref name="Inflection Point">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=faction|Republic|Inflection Point|Odessen}}</ref>

{{GameLSmechanics}}
As a result of the delay in assembling reinforcements to support the Jedi colony, he was forced to request the aid of the [[Eternal Alliance]]'s [[Alliance Commander|Commander]], fearing an Imperial [[Invasion of Ossus|invasion]] on Ossus before he could come to their assistance.<ref name="Inflection Point" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
General Daeruun was a staunch [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] loyalist.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|General Daeruun}}</ref> He greatly enjoyed [[Gatalentan tea/Legends|Gatalentan tea]] offering it to his friends.<ref name="Inflection Point" />

[[File:General_Daeruun_on_Ossus.jpg|thumb|left|250px|General Daeruun on Ossus]]
Despite his hulking and fearsome appearance, he was a person of studious nature with a vast passion for the arts. Although he possessed a natural physical strength, Daeruun had no particular love for battle, therefore rarely having carried a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] with himself. The Krex was tremendously fond of literature, poetry, theater and the visual arts, consequently having decorated his personal quarters with [[Painting/Legends|paintings]] and [[Music/Legends|musical instruments]] he had dabbled with over the years.<ref name="Codex" /> Daeruun's paintings of [[Tau Idair]] in particular won a painting contest in the Republic and was subsequently featured on [[Carrick Station]]. The painting was so popular that Idair received several requests from admirers to be transferred to her unit.<ref name="Paint">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=message|My Face on the Fleet|Tau Idair}}</ref> Daerunn was also liked to play the game [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]] as an enthusiast, discussing new strategies for the game with his close friend [[Dol Narlock]].<ref name="Narlock Codex">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=codex|Vice Admiral Narlock}}</ref>

Daeruun's love of culture and the arts was the primary driver of his enlistment in the military and subsequent years of meritorious service. In his youth, Daeruun's family worked with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vij Markos]] to help resettle [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] from worlds conquered by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], which instilled him with a deep understanding of the cost of any Imperial victory.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SWTOR-Daeruun.jpg|thumb|200px|Promotional image of General Daeruun]]
According to [[Charles Boyd]], the Creative Director of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', the name "Dipolus Daeruun" is a play on the name of [[Darin De Paul]], who voices the character.<ref name="DePaulDarin">{{Reddit|url=r/swtor/comments/a5vivy/voice_actors_in_510/ebpthpc|thread=Voice Actors in 5.10|author=[[Charles Boyd]]|date=2018-12-13|quote=Darin is such a great and talented guy that I just had to find another place to bring him in. And yeah, like you said, Ardinondu '''Dipolus Daeruun'''&hellip; it's right there in the name ;)|archivedate=20200729204210}}</ref>

Republic players can flirt with Daeruun when his ships come to their rescue near the end of the ''Jedi Under Siege'' storyline, regardless of the player's [[Gender/Legends|gender]].<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" />
